holder: King Sultan IBRAHIM ibni al-Marhum Sultan Iskandar
published: King Sultan IBRAHIM ibni al-Marhum Sultan Iskandar (since 31 January 2024)
process: king elected by and from the hereditary rulers of 9 states for a 5-year term; election is on a rotational basis among rulers of the 9 states; prime minister designated from among members of the House of Representatives; following legislative elections, the leader who has support of the majority of members in the House becomes prime minister
cabinet: Cabinet appointed by the prime minister from among members of Parliament with the consent of the king
